items.title: Write-skill / skill convention documents host-neutral core + per-host adapter refs
At least one exemplar skill split (prefer `deft-directive-swarm` or a vertical slice of Phase 3 launch)
Thin SKILL route table: detect → load core + one `references/host-*.md`
Explicit anti-pattern: load all host adapters “just in case”
OpenClaw adapter encodes worktree-before-spawn and babysit → `sessions_spawn` as MUST
Links from OpenClaw host doc (`content/docs/openclaw-agent-host.md`) stay accurate; skill text remains source of truth
